es: Matizar hallazgos rotundos con estructuras impersonales: there is some evidence that, it appears that, it remains unclear whether, to some extent.

teaching.en: It remains unclear whether the new timetable improves sleep.
teaching.es: Sigue sin estar claro si el nuevo horario mejora el sueño.
teaching.explanationEs: It remains unclear whether + cláusula: todavía no hay respuesta. Con la duda se usa whether, no that.
teaching.audioText: It remains unclear whether the new timetable improves sleep.

teaching.en: There is some tentative evidence that longer sleep improves concentration.
teaching.es: Hay algunos indicios provisionales de que dormir más mejora la concentración.
teaching.explanationEs: There is some evidence that… admite que hay datos, pero débiles. Evidence es incontable: no lleva -s.
teaching.audioText: There is some tentative evidence that longer sleep improves concentration.

teaching.en: To some extent, the results are explained by the later start of lessons.
teaching.es: Hasta cierto punto, los resultados se explican por el inicio más tardío de las clases.
teaching.explanationEs: To some extent limita el alcance de la afirmación: es solo una parte de la explicación.
segments: To some extent, the results are explained
by the later start of lessons.
teaching.audioText: To some extent, the results are explained by the later start of lessons.

teaching.en: It appears that screen time affects sleep, although the findings are largely based on what students said.
teaching.es: Parece que el tiempo de pantalla afecta al sueño, aunque los resultados se basan en gran medida en lo que dijeron los estudiantes.
teaching.explanationEs: It appears that… introduce una inferencia prudente; largely reduce la fuerza de la base de datos.
segments: It appears that screen time affects sleep, although the
findings are largely based on what students said.
teaching.audioText: It appears that screen time affects sleep, although the findings are largely based on what students said.

teaching.en: The data indicate that most students sleep too little, but the survey was somewhat limited.
teaching.es: Los datos indican que la mayoría de los estudiantes duerme demasiado poco, pero la encuesta fue algo limitada.
teaching.explanationEs: Indicate es más fuerte que appears; somewhat suaviza una crítica al método.
segments: The data indicate that most students sleep too
little, but the survey was somewhat limited.
teaching.audioText: The data indicate that most students sleep too little, but the survey was somewhat limited.
